title: Binomial expansion in a commutative ring
statement: Let $C$ be a commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], $x,y\in C$, and $N\geq0$ a natural number. Then $(x+y)^N=\sum_{i=0}^{N}\binom Ni x^i y^{N-i}$ in $C$, with $\binom Ni=N!/(i!(N-i)!)$ interpreted in $C$ by the canonical map $\mathbf Z\to C$, $t\mapsto t\cdot1_C$.
